research.title: Measures — Early Years
research.treatment: Experience durations and attend to both start and end before unit fluency.
research.adopted: Actual temporal demonstration with repeat/stop, followed by discussion of starts and ends.
research.rejected: Do not make counting seconds or reading a clock the entry requirement for this qualitative KC.
research.usageRestrictions: Conceptual comparison only, no prose/figures copied; no redistribution licence inferred.
research.limitations: Foreign early-years guidance, younger than Finnish1–2; adaptation is a project decision, not proof of Finnish curriculum requirements or lesson efficacy.

research.title: Timing — Teachers: Early Years
research.treatment: Compare durations in practical activities with adult-supported timing.
research.adopted: An offline comparison of whole familiar events and opportunities for the learner to describe the comparison.
research.rejected: Counting how many objects someone handles is not by itself a measure of elapsed time; motor speed is not the response criterion here.
research.usageRestrictions: University of Cambridge copyright; no source task wording or figures copied.
research.limitations: A comparable activity guide, not an efficacy evaluation or a direct Finnish age-band prescription.
